source_defect.witness: management_event declares local DMLoss without initialization, assigns it only when SW_LOSSGRZ==1, then unconditionally uses DMLoss in TWGRZ=UPTGRZ+LOSSGRZ+DMLoss.

source_defect_nonzero_storage.witness: management_event includes WSO in TWDM/TWLVDM, but mowing_event and grazing removal do not reduce WSO.
source_defect_nonzero_storage.rationale: Avoid false biomass-removal/mass claims until reference-defect policy authorizes a repair or source establishes WSO=0 as invariant.

exact_semantics: Mowing trigger follows biomass/date policy and MXGDMOW fallback.
Mowing reset uses FLTB/FSTB at current DVS, resets dead pools and leaf cohorts, SLA(1)=SLATB(DVS), LAIEXP=LASUM.
Mowing physical removal and DMHRV/DMLOSS follow B1.11 formulas; delay is INT(AFGEN(DELAYMOWTB,DMHRV+DMLOSS)).
Grazing trigger follows biomass/date policy and MXGDGRZ fallback.
Grazing removes UPTGRZ+LOSSGRZ+extra treading proportionally from living stem, dead stem, dead leaf and living leaf cohorts; storage/root are not reduced.
Legacy DMHRV reports UPTGRZ*fraction and DMLOSS reports only extra treading*fraction. Fixed LOSSGRZ removal is therefore tracked separately for physical mass.
Dewooling after event kind 3 reuses mowing reset with DMRESTDEW and forces TDELAY=1.
remaining: Run strict O0/O2 owner test including WSO=0 envelope and fail-closed WSO>0 case on a full checkout.
Compose management candidate atomically with actual and optional potential crop shadows.
Persist dead biomass and management cursor/restart state.
Bind accepted H_AVERAGE forcing for mowing/grazing loss tables.
Adjudicate SW_LOSSGRZ=0 under reference-defect policy before any claim covering that selector.
Qualify retry/restart and event ordering with phenology and crop transaction.
